data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. This timeout usually occurs when trying to load workspaces with over 10,000 items. I recommend using the search and filter functions to narrow down your view, or splitting your large workspaces into smaller, more focused ones. Please also check your browser console to ensure there are no specific network errors occurring during the load attempt. [T-2949] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
